hooks.command: if [ -f "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/tool/build.sh" ]; then "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/tool/build.sh" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/tool" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/marvin"; elif [ ! -f "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/marvin" ]; then echo "marvin: no Go source at ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/tool and no existing binary; marvin is unavailable." >&2; fi; exit 0
